sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报 Dealbook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 Dealbook 峰会的现场采访商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的几位领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zilron Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔隆·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将于 11 月 18 日在 nytimes.com 上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻报道的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望大家能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: Apple built the world's most valuable business by figuring out how to make China work for Apple.
sentences.zh: 苹果公司通过弄清楚如何让中国为苹果服务，打造了世界上最有价值的商业帝国。

sentences.en: But a Times investigation has found that that dynamic has now changed and that China has figured out how to make Apple work for China.
sentences.zh: 但《时报》的一项调查发现，这种动态现在已经发生了变化，中国已经弄清楚了如何让苹果为中国服务。

sentences.en: Sabrina Tavernisi spoke with one of the reporters behind that investigation.
sentences.zh: 萨布丽娜·塔韦尼西采访了该调查背后的其中一位记者。

sentences.en: Jack Niggas.
sentences.zh: 杰克·尼加斯。

sentences.en: Monday, June 14th.
sentences.zh: 6月14日，星期一。

sentences.en: Jack, tell me how you got into this story about
sentences.zh: 杰克，告诉我你是怎么开始关注这个故事的

sentences.en: Apple's relationship with China.
sentences.zh: 苹果与中国的关系。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: So I started covering Apple for The Times in early 2018, when Apple was really starting to push its stance on privacy.
sentences.zh: 因此，我在 2018 年初开始为《时报》报道苹果公司，当时苹果正真正开始推行其隐私立场。

sentences.en: It was becoming a main selling point for
sentences.zh: 这正成为一个主要的卖点

sentences.en: Apple.
sentences.zh: 苹果。

sentences.en: This is when Facebook was facing a lot of scandal about how it was handling user data, and Apple saw that as an opportunity to differentiate itself from its rivals.
sentences.zh: 正是在这个时候，Facebook 面临着关于其如何处理用户数据的巨大丑闻，苹果认为这是一个将其与竞争对手区分开来的机会。

sentences.en: I think it's privacy to us is a human right.
sentences.zh: 我认为隐私对我们来说是一项人权。

sentences.en: It's a civil liberty.
sentences.zh: 这是一项公民自由。

sentences.en: We even see Tim Cook, you know, Apple CEO, in interviews saying privacy is a fundamental human right.
sentences.zh: 我们甚至看到蒂姆·库克，你知道的，苹果首席执行官在采访中说隐私是一项基本人权。

sentences.en: You know, this is like freedom of speech and freedom of the press and privacy is right up there for us.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这就像言论自由和新闻自由一样，隐私对我们来说同样重要。

sentences.en: And so we've always done this.
sentences.zh: 所以我们一直都是这么做的。

sentences.en: Apple was making its pitch to consumers that they can trust their data with Apple.
sentences.zh: 苹果向消费者推销的是，他们可以把数据交给苹果保管。

sentences.en: Now, what was interesting about Apple's push with privacy was I knew that
sentences.zh: 现在，苹果推动隐私保护有趣的地方在于，我知道

sentences.en: Apple was deeply embedded in China.
sentences.zh: 苹果在中国的根基非常深厚。

sentences.en: Apple was manufacturing virtually every Apple device in China, and it was selling $47 billion a year there.
sentences.zh: 苹果几乎所有的苹果设备都在中国制造，每年在那里的销售额高达 470 亿美元。

sentences.en: It's number two market after the United States.
sentences.zh: 这是仅次于美国的第二大市场。

sentences.en: And at the same time, China is ramping up its surveillance and also its censorship operation and was not a country that cared a lot about privacy.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，中国正在加大其监控和审查力度，而且它并不是一个非常关心隐私的国家。

sentences.en: And so I was interested to understand how Apple was reconciling its focus on privacy with the reality that it was so deeply embedded in China.
sentences.zh: 因此，我很想了解苹果是如何将对隐私的关注与它在中国的深厚根基这一现实调和起来的。

sentences.en: Okay, let's start there.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们从那里开始吧。

sentences.en: How did Apple become so deeply embedded in China in the first place?
sentences.zh: 苹果最初是如何在中国扎根如此之深的？

sentences.en: Well, I think we have to go back to the late 1990s.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想我们得回到 20 世纪 90 年代末。

sentences.en: Apple computer, a pioneer in the personal computers and software business has fallen on hard times.
sentences.zh: 苹果电脑，个人电脑和软件业务的先驱，已经陷入了困境。

sentences.en: It decided to lay off 1,300 workers.
sentences.zh: 它决定裁员 1300 人。

sentences.en: This may be surprising to some listeners, but Apple was actually on the brink of bankruptcy at that time.
sentences.zh: 这可能会让一些听众感到惊讶，但当时苹果实际上已经到了破产的边缘。

sentences.en: Apple once promised a computer for everyone, but now the standard computer is not a Mac, but a PC.
sentences.zh: 苹果曾承诺为每个人生产一台电脑，但现在标准电脑不再是 Mac，而是 PC。

sentences.en: And to save the company.
sentences.zh: 为了拯救公司。

sentences.en: Apple computer has named Steve Jobs its interim chief executive officer.
sentences.zh: 苹果电脑已任命史蒂夫·乔布斯为其临时首席执行官。

sentences.en: The board of directors brought back Steve Jobs, their co-founder.
sentences.zh: 董事会请回了他们的联合创始人史蒂夫·乔布斯。

sentences.en: And over the next several years.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几年里。

sentences.en: This is iMac.
sentences.zh: 这是 iMac。

sentences.en: The whole thing is translucent.
sentences.zh: 整个机身都是半透明的。

sentences.en: You can see into it.
sentences.zh: 你能看透它。

sentences.en: It's so cool.
sentences.zh: 太酷了。

sentences.en: Steve Jobs oversaw a few hit products.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫·乔布斯监管了几款热门产品。

sentences.en: There was this colorful iMac.
sentences.zh: 有这款色彩斑斓的 iMac。

sentences.en: It looks like it's from another planet, a planet with better designers.
sentences.zh: 它看起来像是来自另一个星球，一个拥有更好设计师的星球。

sentences.en: How many times have you gone on the road with a CD player and said, oh God, the CD, I didn't bring the CD I wanted to listen to.
sentences.zh: 你带着 CD 播放器出门时有多少次说过，哦天哪，这张 CD，我没带我想听的那张 CD。

sentences.en: And then there was the iPod.
sentences.zh: 然后是 iPod。

sentences.en: To have your whole music library with you at all times is a quantum leap in listening to music.
sentences.zh: 随时随地拥有整个音乐库是音乐聆听上的一次飞跃。

sentences.en: Now, Apple was still actually manufacturing products in the United States.
sentences.zh: 当时，苹果实际上仍在美国制造产品。

sentences.en: But Tim Cook, who was the chief operating officer at the time, realized that it wasn't really sustainable because of high labor costs.
sentences.zh: 但时任首席运营官的蒂姆·库克意识到，由于高昂的劳动力成本，这实际上是不可持续的。

sentences.en: And also there wasn't just a lot of other factories and suppliers in the United States.
sentences.zh: 而且美国也没有大量其他工厂和供应商。

sentences.en: So there wasn't this condensed supply chain.
sentences.zh: 所以这里没有这种紧凑的供应链。

sentences.en: So Apple was starting to move to Asia.
sentences.zh: 因此，苹果开始向亚洲转移。

sentences.en: It was manufacturing in Japan and Taiwan and Korea.
sentences.zh: 它在日本、台湾和韩国进行制造。

sentences.en: And then in 2001, something really interesting on the global stage happened.
sentences.zh: 然后在 2001 年，全球舞台上发生了一件非常有趣的事情。

sentences.en: By adding China to the WTO, we strengthen the organization.
sentences.zh: 通过将中国加入世贸组织，我们加强了该组织。

sentences.en: The World Trade Organization and all of its countries, including the United States, admitted China as a member.
sentences.zh: 世界贸易组织及其所有成员国（包括美国）接纳中国为成员国。

sentences.en: China is not simply agreeing to import more of our products.
sentences.zh: 中国不仅同意进口更多我们的产品。

sentences.en: It is agreeing to import one of democracy's most cherished values, economic freedom.
sentences.zh: 它同意引入民主最珍视的价值观之一：经济自由。

sentences.en: In previous years, China and the communist government had this state-run, tightly controlled economy.
sentences.zh: 在前几年，中国和共产主义政府实行的是这种国家主导、高度控制的经济。

sentences.en: And there were a lot of obstacles to do business there.
sentences.zh: 在那里做生意有很多障碍。

sentences.en: The WTO agreement will move China in the right direction.
sentences.zh: 世贸组织协议将推动中国朝着正确的方向发展。

sentences.en: It will advance the goals America has worked for in China for the past three decades.
sentences.zh: 它将推进美国过去三十年在中国为之努力的目标。

sentences.en: And of course, it will advance our own economic interests.
sentences.zh: 当然，这也将推进我们自身的经济利益。

sentences.en: And so what was really important about China joining the WTO was that it meant that China now had to abide by these international standards for manufacturing and trade.
sentences.zh: 因此，中国加入世贸组织真正重要的一点是，这意味着中国现在必须遵守这些国际制造和贸易标准。

sentences.en: And the Chinese government had to be a little bit more hands-off toward private companies.
sentences.zh: 中国政府对私营企业的管束必须稍微放手一些。

sentences.en: And so Apple decided to try to test the waters there.
sentences.zh: 因此，苹果决定去那里试水。

sentences.en: So China joined the WTO, which meant a company like Apple would have more protections operating there.
sentences.zh: 所以中国加入了世贸组织，这意味着像苹果这样的公司在那里运营时将获得更多保护。

sentences.en: But why did Apple decide to go to China as opposed to expanding, say, in Korea or Japan or Taiwan, where it was already manufacturing stuff?
sentences.zh: 但为什么苹果决定去中国，而不是扩大在韩国、日本或台湾的业务，它已经在那里制造产品了？

sentences.en: Well, Apple was suddenly growing very rapidly.
sentences.zh: 嗯，苹果的增长突然非常迅速。

sentences.en: The iPod had become a smash hit.
sentences.zh: iPod 已经成为空前的热门产品。

sentences.en: And it started to realize that it was going to need more space and more labor to keep up with demand.
sentences.zh: 它开始意识到需要更多的空间和劳动力来跟上需求。

sentences.en: And so China especially was appealing because it obviously had an enormous labor force.
sentences.zh: 因此，中国尤其具有吸引力，因为它显然拥有庞大的劳动力队伍。

sentences.en: There was very rapidly a supply chain that was building out there with many different suppliers already based there, which made manufacturing products easy.
sentences.zh: 那里正在以极快的速度建立供应链，许多不同的供应商已经在那里扎根，这使得制造产品变得容易。

sentences.en: And the Chinese government, crucially, was pouring literally billions of dollars into infrastructure and factories
sentences.zh: 至关重要的是，中国政府向基础设施和工厂投入了数十亿美元的资金

sentences.en: to build out the supply chain and really make it easy for companies like Apple to come in and make these rather advanced products there.
sentences.zh: 以建立供应链，并真正让像苹果这样的公司能够轻松地进入并在那里生产这些相当先进的产品。

sentences.en: And when you say build out the supply chain, what exactly does that mean?
sentences.zh: 当你指建立供应链时，这究竟意味着什么？

sentences.en: What's the government doing?
sentences.zh: 政府在做什么？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: We're talking about paving roads, you know, sometimes right through villages, building power plants, building employee housing, building factories.
sentences.zh: 我们指的是铺设道路，你知道，有时甚至直接穿过村庄，建设发电厂，建造员工宿舍，建造工厂。

sentences.en: Let me give you an example that I think best illustrates this.
sentences.zh: 让我举一个我认为最能说明问题的例子。

sentences.en: So one of my sources was a former senior Apple executive.
sentences.zh: 我的一位消息人士是苹果公司前高级高管。

sentences.en: And he told me about a story in 2004 when Apple was trying to build a large iPod factory in China.
sentences.zh: 他向我讲述了 2004 年的一个故事，当时苹果正试图在中国建造一座大型 iPod 工厂。

sentences.en: And when he visited the site with a partner in China, they were looking around and he wanted to know where they were going to build the factory.
sentences.zh: 当他与中国的合作伙伴一起参观选址时，他们四处查看，他想知道他们要在哪里建厂。

sentences.en: And the partner said, right here.
sentences.zh: 合作伙伴说，就在这里。

sentences.en: And the problem was there was a small mountain in the place where the factory was supposed to be.
sentences.zh: 问题是，在原本应该建厂的地方有一座小山。

sentences.en: And he was confused.
sentences.zh: 他很困惑。

sentences.en: He said, this factory is supposed to be built in six to seven months.
sentences.zh: 他说，这家工厂应该在六到七个月内建成。

sentences.en: There's a mountain there.
sentences.zh: 那里有一座山。

sentences.en: And the partner said, just trust us.
sentences.zh: 合作伙伴说，相信我们吧。

sentences.en: So six to seven months later, you know, my source returned to China.
sentences.zh: 因此，六到七个月后，你知道的，我的消息人士回到了中国。

sentences.en: And he was astonished to see that the mountain was essentially gone.
sentences.zh: 他惊讶地发现那座山基本上已经消失了。

sentences.en: And there was indeed an iPod factory there, almost up and running and employees getting in there.
sentences.zh: 那里确实有一座 iPod 工厂，几乎已经投入运营，员工们也开始进去了。

sentences.en: And that was a show of the Chinese government's might and its investment and its ability to attract a company like Apple.
sentences.zh: 这展示了中国政府的力量、投资以及吸引像苹果这样的公司的能力。

sentences.en: So China is quite literally willing to move mountains for this company.
sentences.zh: 所以中国真的愿意为了这家公司移山填海。

sentences.en: Totally.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: I mean, this really illustrated to Apple that China was where it wanted to be.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这确实向苹果表明，中国就是它想去的地方。

sentences.en: So Apple made a bet on China.
sentences.zh: 因此，苹果押注中国。

sentences.en: And the bet was that China would not only be a great place to do business in the short term, but that the Chinese government and China itself would be a great business partner
sentences.zh: 这场赌博是，中国不仅在短期内是一个做生意的绝佳地方，而且中国政府和中国本身将成为一个伟大的商业伙伴

sentences.en: and not put restrictions on how Apple did business over the long term.
sentences.zh: 并且从长远来看不会对苹果的商业运作施加限制。

sentences.en: And there was no reason to really think otherwise.
sentences.zh: 而且真的没有理由作其他想法。

sentences.en: China had really been moving in just one direction.
sentences.zh: 中国确实一直在朝着一个方向前进。

sentences.en: The place was opening up economically.
sentences.zh: 这个地方在经济上正在开放。

sentences.en: And there was a belief among many economists and politicians and business leaders in the Western world that the more Western companies poured money into China,
sentences.zh: 西方世界的许多经济学家、政治家和商界领袖都坚信，西方公司向中国投入的资金越多，

sentences.en: the more China would economically open up, the more it would politically liberalize, and the more China would resemble the Western world.
sentences.zh: 中国就会在经济上越开放，在政治上越自由化，中国就会越像西方世界。

sentences.en: Okay, so this bet that Apple makes on China in 2004, how quickly does it start to pay off?
sentences.zh: 好的，那么苹果在 2004 年对中国下的这个赌注，多久开始得到回报？

sentences.en: Basically, immediately, it was pretty clear from the early days of the iPod in China that China was going to be able to handle that business.
sentences.zh: 基本上是立刻见效，从 iPod 在中国早期的日子里就很清楚，中国将能够处理好这项业务。

sentences.en: And they made a decision that would actually prove to be far more consequential down the road, and that was to build their next product there.
sentences.zh: 他们做出了一项在日后被证明更为重要的决定，那就是在那里制造他们的下一款产品。

sentences.en: Today, Apple is going to reinvent the phone.
sentences.zh: 今天，苹果要重新发明手机。

sentences.en: And we are calling it iPhone.
sentences.zh: 我们称之为 iPhone。

sentences.en: Now, the iPhone launched in 2007, and...
sentences.zh: 现在，iPhone 于 2007 年发布，并且……

sentences.en: There's always hype surrounding new gadgets from Apple.
sentences.zh: 苹果的新产品总会伴随着各种炒作。

sentences.en: But this is an all-new level.
sentences.zh: 但这达到了一个全新水平。

sentences.en: You know, pretty quickly, it was a hit product.
sentences.zh: 你知道，很快它就成了一款热门产品。

sentences.en: People have even waited in line for several days.
sentences.zh: 人们甚至排了好几天的队。

sentences.en: I've got food here, water's here, some snacks.
sentences.zh: 我这有吃的，水在这，还有些零食。

sentences.en: What about sleeping?
sentences.zh: 那睡觉呢？

sentences.en: Sleeping, I sleep right here on my chair.
sentences.zh: 睡觉，我就睡在椅子上。

sentences.en: In those first few years, the iPhone doubled in sales and doubled in sales and doubled in sales.
sentences.zh: 在最初的几年里，iPhone 的销量翻了一番，又翻了一番，再翻了一番。

sentences.en: And China was keeping up.
sentences.zh: 而中国一直紧跟步伐。

sentences.en: Really, Apple is the story.
sentences.zh: 真的，苹果就是这个故事的主角。

sentences.en: Better than expected earnings.
sentences.zh: 收益好于预期。

sentences.en: Profits up 47%.
sentences.zh: 利润增长 47%。

sentences.en: Strong iPhone sales.
sentences.zh: 强劲的 iPhone 销量。

sentences.en: Strong Mac sales.
sentences.zh: 强劲的 Mac 销量。

sentences.en: And also in 2009, Apple began selling iPhones in China.
sentences.zh: 同样在 2009 年，苹果开始在中国销售 iPhone。

sentences.en: And that is a huge consumer market.
sentences.zh: 那是一个巨大的消费市场。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是的。

sentences.en: And I think Apple saw that from the early days, that this was one reason to get into China.
sentences.zh: 我认为苹果从早期就看到了这一点，这是进入中国的原因之一。

sentences.en: I think the upside over the next couple quarters is all going to be driven by the iPhone, and most notably China, the ramp of China.
sentences.zh: 我认为未来几个季度的上行空间将完全由 iPhone 驱动，最显著的是中国，中国的产能提升。

sentences.en: I know that's going to be a huge opportunity for them.
sentences.zh: 我知道这对他们来说将是一个巨大的机会。

sentences.en: So by this time, 2009, things are going really great.
sentences.zh: 所以到这个时候，即 2009 年，一切都进展得非常顺利。

sentences.en: But there were also some warning signs.
sentences.zh: 但也有一些警告信号。

sentences.en: In 2009, China actually blocked Twitter and Facebook.
sentences.zh: 2009年，中国实际上屏蔽了推特和脸书。

sentences.en: And the following year, China was caught hacking Google and also was trying to censor Google search results.
sentences.zh: 第二年，中国被发现在黑客攻击谷歌，并试图审查谷歌的搜索结果。

sentences.en: And so Google very abruptly pulled out of the country.
sentences.zh: 因此谷歌非常突然地撤出了该国。

sentences.en: And so at that moment, many of the tech companies were either being blocked or were fleeing China.
sentences.zh: 所以在那个时刻，许多科技公司要么被封锁，要么正在逃离中国。

sentences.en: So these moves by the Chinese government seem like signs that, okay, China may be opening up economically, but politically, the country was not liberalizing.
sentences.zh: 因此，中国政府的这些举动似乎表明，好吧，中国可能在经济上在开放，但在政治上，这个国家并没有自由化。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But Apple, meanwhile, was really doubling down and becoming more entrenched in the country.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，苹果实际上正在加码投资，更深地扎根于这个国家。

sentences.en: iPhone sales are skyrocketing.
sentences.zh: iPhone销量正在飙升。

sentences.en: Apple's now selling in China, which is helping that.
sentences.zh: 苹果现在开始在中国销售，这起到了推动作用。

sentences.en: And to keep up, Apple and China are building bigger and bigger factories.
sentences.zh: 为了跟上需求，苹果和中国正在建造越来越大的工厂。

sentences.en: And Apple's dominance continues.
sentences.zh: 苹果的统治地位仍在继续。

sentences.en: The company announced it sold more than two million iPads in less than two months.
sentences.zh: 该公司宣布，在不到两个月的时间里，其iPad销量就超过了200万台。

sentences.en: Apple again decides to build its next new product, the iPad, in China.
sentences.zh: 苹果再次决定将下一款新产品iPad放在中国制造。

sentences.en: Then in 2011.
sentences.zh: 然后到了2011年。

sentences.en: The Tim Cook era begins at Apple.
sentences.zh: 蒂姆·库克时代在苹果开启。

sentences.en: Tim Cook, who really was the mastermind of Apple's entrance into China, is rewarded with the job of CEO after Steve Jobs becomes sick and eventually dies.
sentences.zh: 蒂姆·库克实际上是苹果进军中国的幕后推手，在史蒂夫·乔布斯生病并最终逝世后，他被委任为首席执行官以资奖励。

sentences.en: And then finally, as the biggest affirmation and the biggest evidence of the success of Apple's bet on China.
sentences.zh: 最后，作为苹果押注中国成功的最大肯定和最大证据。

sentences.en: Apple is now the most valuable company on the face of the planet.
sentences.zh: 苹果现在是地球上最具价值的公司。

sentences.en: Apple becomes the world's most valuable company, surpassing ExxonMobil.
sentences.zh: 苹果超越埃克森美孚，成为全球最具价值的公司。

sentences.en: Yep, it was all because of the iPhone and the iPad, Andrew.
sentences.zh: 没错，这一切都归功于iPhone和iPad，安德鲁。

sentences.en: These two gadgets.
sentences.zh: 就是这两款小玩意儿。

sentences.en: At this point, Apple is really on top of the world.
sentences.zh: 此时的苹果真正立于世界之巅。

sentences.en: And that never would have been possible without China.
sentences.zh: 如果没有中国，这一切是绝对不可能实现的。

sentences.en: But shortly after that, China starts to change the terms of its relationship with Apple.
sentences.zh: 但不久之后，中国开始改变与苹果合作关系的条款。

sentences.en: And things become a lot more complicated.
sentences.zh: 事情变得复杂得多了。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: So, Jack, you were talking about changes happening in China that really kind of changed the terms of the bet Apple was making.
sentences.zh: 那么，杰克，你刚才提到中国发生的变化，实际上改变了苹果这场豪赌的条款。

sentences.en: What were those changes?
sentences.zh: 这些变化是什么？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Well, it really has to do with the leadership of the Chinese Communist Party.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这确实与中国共产党的领导层有关。

sentences.en: So, in 2013, there is a change in government.
sentences.zh: 因此，在2013年，政府发生了更迭。

sentences.en: And a new president assumes power, Xi Jinping.
sentences.zh: 一位新总统习近平上台执政。

sentences.en: And he has a very different style than his predecessors.
sentences.zh: 他的执政风格与前任大不相同。

sentences.en: And from that day on, the relationship between Apple and China fundamentally changed.
sentences.zh: 从那天起，苹果与中国的关系发生了根本性的变化。

sentences.en: How so?
sentences.zh: 怎么说？

sentences.en: Well, I can actually just start with literally the first week of the presidency.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我其实可以从他上任的第一周说起。

sentences.en: So, he assumes power on March 14th, 2013.
sentences.zh: 他于2013年3月14日上任。

sentences.en: And the very next day, Apple was under attack.
sentences.zh: 就在第二天，苹果就遭到了抨击。

sentences.en: China Central Television, which was the main government broadcaster, aired a report criticizing Apple.
sentences.zh: 作为主要的官方广播机构，中国中央电视台播出了批评苹果的报道。

sentences.en: And basically, they were saying that Apple doesn't issue long enough warranties for its products.
sentences.zh: 基本上，他们的意思是苹果对其产品的保修期不够长。

sentences.en: The implication was that Apple was ripping off Chinese consumers.
sentences.zh: 其潜台词是苹果在坑害中国消费者。

sentences.en: And very quickly, there was this coordinated criticism of the company across Chinese society.
sentences.zh: 很快，中国社会各界对该公司展开了一致的批评。

sentences.en: The Chinese state-owned newspapers were calling Apple a quote-unquote scoundrel.
sentences.zh: 中国国有报纸称苹果为所谓的“恶棍”。

sentences.en: Chinese celebrities were all criticizing the company on social media.
sentences.zh: 中国名人们纷纷在社交媒体上批评该公司。

sentences.en: And it was really clear that this was a sign on, you know, just the second day of Xi Jinping's administration that the Chinese government was taking a different tact with Apple.
sentences.zh: 很明显，这是习近平政府上台仅仅第二天释放出的一个信号，表明中国政府对苹果采取了不同的策略。

sentences.en: But why?
sentences.zh: 但为什么呢？

sentences.en: Why would Xi Jinping and the Communist Party decide to attack Apple so suddenly after this incredibly successful and profitable relationship they had cultivated for more than a decade?
sentences.zh: 在培育了十多年极其成功且利润丰厚的合作关系之后，为什么习近平和共产党会突然决定攻击苹果？

sentences.en: Well, it's because Xi Jinping had very different plans for China.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那是因为习近平对中国有着截然不同的规划。

sentences.en: He comes to the presidency with a belief that China must regain its position as the most powerful economic and military force in the world.
sentences.zh: 他带着一种信念就任总统：中国必须重新夺回其作为世界最具经济和军事实力地位的宝座。

sentences.en: And to do that, Xi was trying to reduce China's dependence and go after the Western companies like Apple that had really been amassing a lot of influence in the country.
sentences.zh: 为了做到这一点，习近平试图减少中国对西方企业的依赖，并对付那些在该国积累了巨大影响力的西方公司，比如苹果。

sentences.en: And really lift up some of the homegrown tech companies like Baidu and Tencent and Alibaba.
sentences.zh: 同时大力扶持百度、腾讯和阿里巴巴等本土科技公司。

sentences.en: And a big reason why China was changing its approach was because China could.
sentences.zh: 中国改变方法的很大一个原因在于中国有这个能力。

sentences.en: China suddenly had a lot more leverage and it had a lot more economic power, in part because of the investment from Apple and other Western companies.
sentences.zh: 中国突然拥有了更多的话语权和更强的经济实力，部分原因正是来自苹果和其他西方公司的投资。

sentences.en: You know, by 2013, China was the world's number two economy.
sentences.zh: 要知道，到2013年，中国已经是世界第二大经济体。

sentences.en: And that is a very different place than it was in 2001.
sentences.zh: 这与2001年时的状况大不相同。

sentences.en: And it meant that Xi Jinping had more power and more ability to get his way.
sentences.zh: 这意味着习近平拥有更大的权力和更多的能力来贯彻自己的意志。

sentences.en: So how does Apple respond to this attack by Xi Jinping?
sentences.zh: 那么苹果如何回应习近平的这次攻击呢？

sentences.en: Well,
sentences.zh: 嗯，

sentences.en: Apple trying to save face in one of its fastest growing markets.
sentences.zh: 苹果在其增长最快的市场之一试图挽回面子。

sentences.en: That's for sure.
sentences.zh: 这是肯定的。

sentences.en: Within several weeks, Tim Cook took a really unusual step.
sentences.zh: 几周内，蒂姆·库克采取了一个非常寻常的举动。

sentences.en: An unexpected apology this morning from Apple to the Chinese people.
sentences.zh: 苹果今天上午向中国人民做出了一次意料之外的道歉。

sentences.en: He issued an open letter and he apologized.
sentences.zh: 他发表了一封公开信并表达了歉意。

sentences.en: Tim Cook saying, quote, we recognize that we have much to learn about operating and communicating in China.
sentences.zh: 蒂姆·库克表示：“我们认识到，我们在中国运营和沟通方面还有很多东西需要学习。”

sentences.en: And said that Apple had, quote, incomparable respect for China and that Apple had a lot to learn about operating in the country.
sentences.zh: 并表示苹果对中国“怀有无与伦比的敬意”，并且苹果在这个国家的运营方面有许多需要学习的地方。

sentences.en: A humbler Apple, if that's possible here.
sentences.zh: 一个更加谦逊的苹果，如果在这里这是可能的话。

sentences.en: And it was a real sign that the dynamics of this relationship had fundamentally changed.
sentences.zh: 这确实是一个信号，表明这种关系的动态已经发生了根本性的变化。

sentences.en: So did this new stance from the Chinese government ring any alarm bells inside the company?
sentences.zh: 那么，中国政府的新立场是否在公司内部敲响了警钟？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Pretty quickly, there were these conversations inside of Apple about the dilemma that they faced in China.
sentences.zh: 很快，苹果内部就开始讨论他们在中国面临的困境。

sentences.en: And specifically, there was this former Apple employee who was a senior advisor in China.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，当时有一位前苹果员工担任中国区的高级顾问。

sentences.en: And he told me that early on, he realized the predicament Apple was in.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，他很早就意识到了苹果所处的困境。

sentences.en: And he tried to get the company's leadership to do something about it.
sentences.zh: 并试图让公司领导层采取行动。

sentences.en: And so he was able to get an audience with some of Tim Cook's top deputies and make the case that Apple had basically no plan B to China.
sentences.zh: 因此，他得以与蒂姆·库克的几位顶级副手会面，并陈述了苹果对中国基本没有B计划的事实。

sentences.en: And that really left the company vulnerable to the whims of the government.
sentences.zh: 这确实让公司变得容易受政府意愿的摆布。

sentences.en: But ultimately, nothing really changed at Apple.
sentences.zh: 但最终，苹果并没有真正发生什么变化。

sentences.en: And that was in part because there was really no other country that could support the type of manufacturing that Apple now required.
sentences.zh: 部分原因是因为确实没有其他国家能够支持苹果目前所需的这种规模的制造能力。

sentences.en: And there was certainly no consumer market that could make up for the lost sales if Apple had to leave China.
sentences.zh: 如果苹果不得不撤出中国，也绝对没有任何消费市场能够弥补销售额的损失。

sentences.en: So Apple was stuck.
sentences.zh: 所以苹果被困住了。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: So how does this new chapter of the relationship between Apple and China play out?
sentences.zh: 那么苹果与中国关系的新篇章将如何展开？

sentences.en: Well, for Apple, you know, from a business standpoint, things continue to go wonderfully.
sentences.zh: 嗯，对苹果而言，从商业角度来看，事情进展得依然非常顺利。

sentences.en: Apple's valuation is skyrocketing.
sentences.zh: 苹果的估值正在飙升。

sentences.en: People continue to not be able to get enough of its products.
sentences.zh: 人们对它的产品依然趋之若鹜。

sentences.en: But its situation in China is continuing to get hairier.
sentences.zh: 但它在中国的情况却变得越来越棘手。

sentences.en: And that's in part because over the next several years, we're starting to see that the administration of Xi Jinping is an increasingly authoritarian one.
sentences.zh: 部分原因是因为在接下来的几年里，我们开始看到习近平政府正日益走向威权。

sentences.en: Xi's government is building out a nationwide video surveillance network.
sentences.zh: 习近平的政府正在建设全国性的视频监控网络。

sentences.en: They are getting more access to the data of China's biggest internet companies like Tencent.
sentences.zh: 他们获得了更多访问腾讯等中国最大互联网公司数据的权限。

sentences.en: And they are starting to become much stricter internet censors and cracking down more and more on what people can say and read on the internet.
sentences.zh: 他们开始成为更加严格的互联网审查者，并对人们在互联网上能说和能读的内容进行越来越多的打击。

sentences.en: And that was a worrying sign for Apple.
sentences.zh: 这对苹果来说是一个令人担忧的信号。

sentences.en: You know, as the iPhone began to sell more and more in China, Apple was increasingly a gateway to the internet for Chinese citizens.
sentences.zh: 你知道，随着iPhone在中国的销量越来越大，苹果越来越成为中国公民通往互联网的门户。

sentences.en: And then in the summer of 2017...
sentences.zh: 然后在2017年夏天……

sentences.en: The new law was approved by China's National People's Congress.
sentences.zh: 新法律获得了中国全国人大常委会的批准。

sentences.en: This new Chinese cybersecurity law went into effect.
sentences.zh: 这部新的中国网络安全法正式生效。

sentences.en: That was a big deal for Apple.
sentences.zh: 这对苹果来说是一件大事。

sentences.en: China says it's necessary to safeguard cybersecurity and protect against hackers from within and outside.
sentences.zh: 中国表示，这是维护网络安全、防范来自内部和外部黑客攻击的必要举措。

sentences.en: And what exactly is this new cybersecurity law in China?
sentences.zh: 那么中国这项新的网络安全法究竟是什么？

sentences.en: So the law requires tech companies to store data that is created in China, in China.
sentences.zh: 该法律要求科技公司将在中国境内产生的数据存储在中国境内。

sentences.en: Companies in key industries will need to open up their computer systems for security examinations.
sentences.zh: 关键行业的公司需要开放其计算机系统以进行安全审查。

sentences.en: Most of their data will need to be stored locally and crime investigations will have access to that data.
sentences.zh: 它们的大部分数据都需要在本地存储，犯罪调查将能够访问这些数据。

sentences.en: And that's bad news for Apple because of iCloud.
sentences.zh: 这对苹果来说是个坏消息，因为有iCloud。

sentences.en: Now, iCloud is Apple's data storage service that millions of Chinese consumers use to store personal, private data like their contacts, documents, photos, emails,
sentences.zh: 现在，iCloud是苹果的数据存储服务，数百万中国消费者用它来存储个人隐私数据，比如他们的联系人、文档、照片、电子邮件，

sentences.en: even their real-time locations.
sentences.zh: 甚至他们的实时位置。

sentences.en: Prior to this law, Apple stored this data largely outside of China.
sentences.zh: 在此法出台之前，苹果基本上将这些数据存储在中国境外。

sentences.en: And this data was encrypted, which meant it could only be accessed with certain digital encryption keys.
sentences.zh: 这些数据是经过加密的，这意味着只有使用某些数字加密密钥才能访问它们。

sentences.en: And Apple kept those digital keys to unlock the data outside of China as well.
sentences.zh: 而且苹果也将用于解锁数据的那些数字密钥存放在中国境外。

sentences.en: Well, under the new law, China wants Apple to bring that data to China and store that data on Chinese government servers.
sentences.zh: 根据新法律，中国希望苹果将这些数据带到中国，并存储在中国政府的服务器上。

sentences.en: And it also wants Apple to bring the digital keys to those servers as well.
sentences.zh: 它还希望苹果将这些服务器的数字密钥也带到中国。

sentences.en: So China wants Apple to store its Chinese users' data on government-owned servers and to have the key to unlock that data also located in China.
sentences.zh: 因此，中国希望苹果将其中国用户的数据存储在政府拥有的服务器上，并且用于解锁该数据的密钥也位于中国境内。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So basically, this means that if Apple complied with the government's demands, Apple's Chinese customers' data would effectively be in the hands of the Chinese government.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上这意味着，如果苹果顺应政府的要求，苹果中国客户的数据实际上将落入中国政府手中。

sentences.en: So what does Apple do?
sentences.zh: 那么苹果会怎么做？

sentences.en: Well, this is basically what I've been trying to answer for almost two years.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这基本上就是我近两年来一直试图回答的问题。

sentences.en: So over the course of these years, my colleagues, Ray Zhang, Dai Wakabayashi, and I managed to obtain internal Apple documents.
sentences.zh: 所以在过去的这些年里，我的同事雷·张、戴·若林和我设法获取了苹果内部文件。

sentences.en: We spoke to 17 current and former Apple employees and also independent security experts.
sentences.zh: 我们采访了17名苹果现任和前任员工，以及独立的安全专家。

sentences.en: And here's what we found.
sentences.zh: 以下是我们的发现。

sentences.en: Apple essentially decides that it's willing to store the data in China.
sentences.zh: 苹果基本上决定愿意将数据存储在中国。

sentences.en: But in negotiations, Apple really tried to keep the encryption keys outside of the country,
sentences.zh: 但在谈判中，苹果确实试图将加密密钥保留在国外，

sentences.en: which would essentially protect the data and make it almost unusable for the Chinese government.
sentences.zh: 这基本上可以保护数据，并使中国政府几乎无法使用这些数据。

sentences.en: Now, we don't know exactly what Apple was doing and saying to make its case to the Chinese government.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们不知道苹果究竟做了什么、说了什么来向中国政府陈述其立场。

sentences.en: And we don't know exactly how the Chinese government responded.
sentences.zh: 我们也不知道中国政府是如何回应的。

sentences.en: But what we do know is that by 2018, those encryption keys did in fact end up in China, along with the user data, in a Chinese-controlled data center.
sentences.zh: 但我们所知道的是，到2018年，这些加密密钥确实最终同用户数据一起，落入了中国境内一个受中国控制的数据中心。

sentences.en: So, in effect, China won.
sentences.zh: 所以实际上，中国赢了。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Now, Apple has told us in response to our findings that it is doing everything it can to keep its customers' data safe.
sentences.zh: 现在，苹果在回应我们的调查结果时告诉我们，它正在尽一切努力保护其客户的数据安全。

sentences.en: It also said that it's retained control of the encryption keys in China.
sentences.zh: 它还表示，它保留了在中国加密密钥的控制权。

sentences.en: And specifically, it said that it designed the security of its iCloud system, quote, in such a way that only Apple has control of the encryption keys, end quote.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，它表示其设计iCloud系统安全的方式是，引述：“只有苹果拥有加密密钥的控制权。”

sentences.en: It didn't elaborate beyond that.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，它没有做更多详细说明。

sentences.en: But what we do know is that those encryption keys are stored on the Chinese data centers.
sentences.zh: 但我们所知道的是，这些加密密钥确实存储在中国的数据中心上。

sentences.en: Now, we obtained internal documents that explain the design and security of the iCloud system.
sentences.zh: 我们获取了阐述iCloud系统设计与安全的内部文件。

sentences.en: And we shared those documents and some of our findings with four independent security experts.
sentences.zh: 我们将这些文件以及我们的一些发现分享给了四位独立的的安全专家。

sentences.en: And those experts said that because the encryption keys are stored in China, and not only in China but on computers owned and run by the Chinese government,
sentences.zh: 这些专家表示，由于加密密钥存储在中国，而且不仅在中国，还存储在由中国政府拥有和运营的计算机上，

sentences.en: that makes it an impossible problem for Apple engineers to solve.
sentences.zh: 这使得它成为了一个苹果工程师根本无法解决的问题。

sentences.en: You know, anything can be hacked.
sentences.zh: 你知道，任何东西都可以被黑客攻击。

sentences.en: But when we're talking about the actual physical servers containing the data in the hands of a sophisticated hacker like the Chinese government,
sentences.zh: 但当我们谈论包含数据的实际物理服务器落入像中国政府这样老练的黑客手中时，

sentences.en: it becomes extremely difficult to protect that data.
sentences.zh: 保护这些数据就变得极其困难。

sentences.en: Do we know if China has actually accessed any user data that was made more accessible, as you said, under this law?
sentences.zh: 我们知道中国是否真正访问了任何用户数据吗？正如你所说，根据这项法律，这些数据变得更容易获取了。

sentences.en: No, we don't know.
sentences.zh: 不，我们不知道。

sentences.en: What we do know is that the security experts said that Apple's compromises in China have made it nearly impossible for the company
sentences.zh: 我们所知道的是，安全专家表示，苹果在中国的妥协使得该公司几乎不可能

sentences.en: to stop the Chinese government from gaining access to the data.
sentences.zh: 阻止中国政府获取这些数据。

sentences.en: And we also know that this is not the only compromise Apple's making in China.
sentences.zh: 我们也知道，这并不是苹果在中国做出的唯一妥协。

sentences.en: What we found is that Apple is also becoming a tool of the Chinese government's vast censorship operation.
sentences.zh: 我们发现苹果也正在成为中国政府庞大审查机器的一个工具。

sentences.en: And it all has to do with Apple's App Store.
sentences.zh: 这一切都与苹果的App Store有关。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: So we've known for a while that the Chinese government has asked Apple to take down apps.
sentences.zh: 我们早就知道中国政府曾要求苹果下架应用。

sentences.en: And we know that in some cases Apple takes them down, in some cases Apple doesn't.
sentences.zh: 我们也知道在某些情况下苹果会下架，而在某些情况下苹果不会。

sentences.en: But what we found is over the past several years, Apple has begun to build this sophisticated system inside of its company
sentences.zh: 但我们发现，在过去几年里，苹果开始在其公司内部建立一个复杂的系统，

sentences.en: that is designed to take down apps proactively before the Chinese government even asks if it thinks the app could upset Chinese officials or run afoul of Chinese laws.
sentences.zh: 该系统旨在如果认为某个应用可能会惹恼中国官员或触犯中国法律，即便中国政府尚未提出要求，也要主动将其下架。

sentences.en: And so as part of that system, Apple has created essentially a blacklist of terms that are banned in China.
sentences.zh: 作为该系统的一部分，苹果基本上创建了一个在中国被禁用的术语黑名单。

sentences.en: And these are things like independence for Tibet and Taiwan, the Chinese spiritual movement Falun Gong, the Dalai Lama, and the names of certain Chinese dissidents.
sentences.zh: 其中包括西藏和台湾独立、中国精神运动法轮功、达赖喇嘛以及某些中国异见人士的名字。

sentences.en: And Apple actually hires hundreds of its own app reviewers.
sentences.zh: 苹果甚至聘请了数百名自己的应用审核人员。

sentences.en: And then it trains them on what topics to look for.
sentences.zh: 然后培训他们注意哪些主题。

sentences.en: And it also creates software that scans each app for the banned terMs.
sentences.zh: 它还开发了扫描每个应用中违禁词汇的软件。

sentences.en: And so as a result, Apple has removed tens of thousands of apps in China to appease Chinese authorities.
sentences.zh: 因此，为了取悦中国当局，苹果在中国下架了数万款应用。

sentences.en: And those include apps from foreign news outlets like the New York Times, gay dating apps, apps that get around the government's internet restrictions,
sentences.zh: 其中包括来自《纽约时报》等外国新闻机构的应用、同性恋交友应用、绕过政府互联网限制的应用，

sentences.en: and apps that helped pro-democracy protesters in Hong Kong organize.
sentences.zh: 以及帮助香港民主抗议者进行组织的应用程序。

sentences.en: So Apple is proactively searching for topics in its own app store that the Chinese government deems off-limits and removing a bunch of them.
sentences.zh: 因此，苹果正在其自身的应用商店中主动搜寻中国政府认为属于禁区的话题，并删除了其中一大批内容。

sentences.en: It's pretty extraordinary for an American company to play this role.
sentences.zh: 对于一家美国公司来说，扮演这样的角色实在是非同寻常。

sentences.en: It really is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And it essentially means that Apple, one of the most technologically advanced and richest companies in the world, is bringing to bear its technology and its resources
sentences.zh: 这基本上意味着，作为世界上技术最先进、最富有的公司之一，苹果正在动用它的技术和资源

sentences.en: to help the Chinese government censor the internet for Chinese citizens.
sentences.zh: 来协助中国政府对中国公民的互联网进行审查。

sentences.en: What does Apple have to say about all of this?
sentences.zh: 苹果对此有何说法？

sentences.en: How does Apple defend its decision to comply with these pretty authoritarian demands from China?
sentences.zh: 苹果是如何为自己顺从中国这些颇具威权色彩的要求这一决定进行辩护的？

sentences.en: Well, in a statement Apple gave us in response to our story, they said, quote, these decisions are not always easy, and we may not agree with the laws that shape them,
sentences.zh: 嗯，在苹果就我们的报道给出的声明中，他们说，引述如下：这些决定并不总是容易的，我们可能并不认同塑造这些决定的法律，

sentences.en: but our priority remains creating the best user experience without violating the rules we are obligated to follow.
sentences.zh: 但我们的首要任务依然是在不违反我们有义务遵守的规则的前提下，创造最佳的用户体验。

sentences.en: Apple basically says that while it doesn't like these rules, they're the law.
sentences.zh: 苹果基本上是说，虽然它不喜欢这些规则，但它们就是法律。

sentences.en: And Apple follows the law in the countries in which it does business.
sentences.zh: 而且苹果在其开展业务的国家都会遵守法律。

sentences.en: But obviously, this is an uncomfortable situation for Apple.
sentences.zh: 但很显然，这对苹果来说是个尴尬的处境。

sentences.en: From my American mindset, I believe strongly in freedoMs.
sentences.zh: 从我的美国思维来看，我坚信自由。

sentences.en: And in 2017, Tim Cook was asked about Apple's relationship with China.
sentences.zh: 而在2017年，蒂姆·库克被问及苹果与中国的关系时，

sentences.en: But I also know that each country in the world decides their laws and their regulations.
sentences.zh: 但我也知道，世界上每个国家都会决定自己的法律和法规。

sentences.en: And so your choice is, do you participate?
sentences.zh: 所以你的选择是，你要参与吗？

sentences.en: Or do you stand on the sideline and yell at how things should be?
sentences.zh: 还是说你站在局外，对事情该怎么做大喊大叫？

sentences.en: And my own view very strongly is, you show up and you participate.
sentences.zh: 而我个人的观点非常坚定，那就是你必须出现并参与。

sentences.en: You get in the arena because nothing ever changes from the sideline.
sentences.zh: 你得进入竞技场，因为在局外什么都不会改变。

sentences.en: And he basically argued that Chinese citizens and the world at large are better off with Apple in China.
sentences.zh: 他基本上辩称，对于中国公民和整个世界来说，苹果留在中国会更好。

sentences.en: I have this 25-year view of China.
sentences.zh: 我对中国有着长达25年的观察视角。

sentences.en: So I've seen so much change in that quarter of a century.
sentences.zh: 所以我见证了这四分之一个世纪里的巨大变化。

sentences.en: And to me, the arc of that is clear.
sentences.zh: 对我而言，其发展轨迹是很清晰的。

sentences.en: Now, it doesn't mean that it's a straight line.
sentences.zh: 当然，这并不意味着它是一条直线。

sentences.en: But honestly speaking, in no country in the world is progress a straight line.
sentences.zh: 但老实说，世界上没有任何一个国家的进步是一条直线。

sentences.en: And his argument is that even though China is changing,
sentences.zh: 他的论点是，尽管中国在变，

sentences.en: Apple has more of a chance to influence the country if it stays in the country than if it leaves and is just on the sidelines.
sentences.zh: 但与离开并只当局外人相比，如果苹果留在国内，它将有更多机会对这个国家产生影响。

sentences.en: So given all of this, these compromises that Apple has felt compelled to make, is the company doing anything now to fundamentally change its reliance on China?
sentences.zh: 那么鉴于这一切，鉴于苹果觉得不得不做出的这些妥协，这家公司现在有没有采取任何行动来根本性地改变它对中国的依赖？

sentences.en: Not fundamentally.
sentences.zh: 没有根本性的改变。

sentences.en: Apple has begun to diversify in some very small ways.
sentences.zh: 苹果已经开始以一些非常微小的方式进行多元化布局。

sentences.en: It is now assembling a small number of iPhones in India.
sentences.zh: 它现在正开始在印度组装少量的iPhone。

sentences.en: It's making AirPods in Vietnam, for instance.
sentences.zh: 比如它正在越南制造AirPods。

sentences.en: But for the most part, Apple still makes the vast majority of its devices in China.
sentences.zh: 但总的来说，苹果绝大多数的设备依然是在中国制造。

sentences.en: And the latest signs from its supplier report show that it's using an even higher percentage of suppliers in China than it did before.
sentences.zh: 而且其供应商报告的最新迹象显示，它在中国的供应商比例甚至比以前更高了。

sentences.en: So, Jack, I'm thinking about this bet that you mentioned early on, the bet that Apple made on China, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以，杰克，我在想你早先提到过的那场豪赌，也就是苹果对中国押下的赌注，你知道的，

sentences.en: that it would remain a hospitable place to do business and be a good partner in the long run.
sentences.zh: 即从长远来看，中国仍将是一个适合做生意且能成为良好合作伙伴的地方。

sentences.en: How should we think about that bet now?
sentences.zh: 我们现在该如何看待那场赌注？

sentences.en: So, from an economic standpoint, Apple's bet on China has been one of the biggest successes in modern business history.
sentences.zh: 所以，从经济角度来看，苹果对中国的押注一直是现代商业史上最大的成功之一。

sentences.en: Apple is the most valuable company in the world, and it is the richest company in the world and the most profitable company in the world.
sentences.zh: 苹果是世界上最有价值的公司，也是世界上最富有的公司和最赚钱的公司。

sentences.en: But at the same time, Apple was in some ways making a bet that its entrance into China, its investment in China,
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，在某种程度上，苹果押注的是它进入中国、它对中国的投资，

sentences.en: would force China to open up and to liberalize and to reflect more of the values that Apple itself believes in.
sentences.zh: 将会迫使中国开放、走向自由化，并更多地体现苹果自身所信仰的价值观。

sentences.en: So, at the outset, I think that Apple believed that it could change China.
sentences.zh: 所以在最初，我认为苹果相信它能够改变中国。

sentences.en: But two decades later, it seems to be clearer that China has instead changed Apple.
sentences.zh: 但二十年过去了，情况似乎变得更加明朗，反倒是中国改变了苹果。

sentences.en: And
sentences.zh: 并且

sentences.en: I think that Apple's relationship with the Chinese government reflects a new reality in which the world's soon-to-be number one economy is run by an increasingly authoritarian government that is willing to squash pro-democracy protesters and also commit human rights abuses when it comes to the Uyghurs,
sentences.zh: 我认为苹果与中国政府的关系反映了一种全新现实：这个即将成为世界第一大经济体的国家，正由一个日益独裁的政府所统治，该政府不仅愿意镇压亲民主抗议者，在维吾尔族（即该国的穆斯林少数民族）问题上还犯有人权虐待行为，

sentences.en: which is the Muslim ethnic minority in the country.
sentences.zh: 也就是该国的穆斯林少数民族。

sentences.en: And because of the nature of the global economy, where China is one of the largest consumer markets, and more importantly,
sentences.zh: 而且由于全球经济的特性，中国既是最大的消费市场之一，更重要的是，

sentences.en: the home to the most sophisticated and largest supply chain in the world, it means that Western industry will now be grappling for years to come on how to deal with this new China.
sentences.zh: 它还是世界上最成熟、最大规模供应链的发源地，这意味着西方产业在未来数年内都将不得不艰难应对如何与这个新中国打交道的问题。

sentences.en: Thank you very much, Jack.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你，杰克。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: Benjamin Netanyahu's long and divisive time as Prime Minister of Israel ended on Sunday, when the country's parliament gave its support to a diverse coalition of his opponents.
sentences.zh: 本杰明·内塔尼亚胡漫长而充满争议的以色列总理任期于周日画上句号，当天该国议会对其反对派组成的多党派执政联盟给予了支持。

sentences.en: The margin of victory was razor-thin, 60 to 59, with one lawmaker abstaining.
sentences.zh: 获胜优势微乎其微，为60票对59票，有一名议员弃权。

sentences.en: Prime Minister-designate, please.
sentences.zh: 候任总理，请。

sentences.en: After the vote, supporters of Netanyahu repeatedly heckled his successor, Prime Minister-designate, Naftali Bennett, who vowed in a speech to be a leader for all of Israel.
sentences.zh: 投票结束后，内塔尼亚胡的支持者多次起哄嘲弄他的继任者、候任总理纳夫塔利·贝内特，后者在演讲中发誓要做一个代表全以色列的领袖。

sentences.en: Friends, even if you're not in the government, we will represent your voters and we will look after everyone.
sentences.zh: 朋友们，即使你们不在政府里，我们也会代表你们的选民，照顾好每一个人。

sentences.en: And
sentences.zh: 而且

sentences.en: America is back at the table.
sentences.zh: 美国重返谈判桌。

sentences.en: On Sunday, President Biden ended a summit of the Group of Seven, where he met with the heads of Canada, France, Germany, Italy,
sentences.zh: 周日，拜登总统结束了七国集团峰会，在那里他会晤了加拿大、法国、德国、意大利、

sentences.en: Japan and the United Kingdom by declaring that the United States was eager to resume its role as a leader in global affairs after four years of an America First policy under Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 日本和英国的领导人，并宣称在经历了唐纳德·特朗普“美国优先”政策的四年之后，美国渴望恢复其在全球事务中的领导者角色。

sentences.en: The lack of participation.
sentences.zh: 过去缺乏参与。

sentences.en: The lack of participation in the past and full engagement was noticed significantly, not only by the leaders of those countries, but by the people in the G7 countries.
sentences.zh: 过去缺乏参与和充分投入受到了极大的关注，不仅是这些国家的领导人，七国集团各国的人民也都有所察觉。

sentences.en: And America is back in the business of leading the world alongside nations who share our most deeply held values.
sentences.zh: 而且美国重新开始与那些拥有我们最深厚价值观的国家并肩引领世界。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Stella Tan, Austin Mitchell, and Soraya Shockley.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由斯特拉·谭、奥斯汀·米切尔和索拉亚·肖克利制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Lisa Chow, engineered by Chris Wood, and contains original music from Dan Powell and Marion Lozano.
sentences.zh: 由丽莎·周剪辑，克里斯·伍德混音，并包含丹·鲍威尔和马里昂·洛扎诺的原创音乐。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine, until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器运作，直到今年夏天，选举迎来了大批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党就陷入了一场激烈、混乱、有时甚至扣人心弦的权力争斗中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在由我（萨拉·科尼格）主持的《都市》最新一期节目中，将为您讲述人们试图维持自身影响却在过程中逐渐失控的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 都市。

sentences.zh: 请在您获取播客的任何平台上收听。
